T9 is powered and held by a §9beam of pellets§r fired down the collimator stack. Three grades, each pressed on the §9Kerr Compressor Module§r (Kerr T2, 30 s at UXV, 16 a craft) from the grade below:
- §9Magnetar§r, 1.25 EeV: 72 L Magnetar Matter, 1,000 L Degenerate Stellar Mixture, 2 Casimir Plates. A primer, too weak to hold a flow alone.
- §9Ergomatter§r, 5 EeV: 4 Magnetar pellets + 1,000 L Ergomatter.
- §9Superdense§r, 20 EeV: 4 Ergomatter pellets + 144 L Superdense Ergomatter. The working fuel.

1 EeV is 10 to the 9 GeV. The top grade carries T6, T7 and T8 matter at once: one pellet holds 9 L Superdense, 15.6 L Ergomatter and 0.28 L Magnetar Matter. A standard T9 fires about§9 2,000 an hour§r: 0.9 of a T8, 0.73 of a T7 and 0.5 of a T6 in upkeep.

Every grade stays under the §9GZK limit§r (50 EeV), where real cosmic rays start losing energy to the microwave background. The top grade sits at 40 % of it.

§5§lAUTOMATE§r Patterns on the Kerr Compressor: Magnetar → Ergomatter → Superdense, and a level emitter on the Superdense pellets.

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold 64 Superdense pellets.
